QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also off (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shipped config leaves the threading macros (THREADING_C, PTHREAD, ALT) undefined by default, so a default build defines none of them.
